analysis.headline: Shares Your Data for Ads
analysis.quote: Your personal data may be disclosed to third parties (see X) that might be located outside your country of residence; potentially, different data protection standards may apply (see XII).

analysis.headline: Profiles You for Ads
analysis.quote: The use of your personal data for behavioural advertising and profiling is done with consent, Article 6 sec. 1 sent. 1 lit. a GDPR.

analysis.headline: Your Data Sent Abroad
analysis.quote: Your personal data may be transferred to and processed inside and outside of the EEA. For further information about the potential risks of a cross border data transfer refer to XI.

analysis.headline: Third Parties Track You
analysis.quote: Personal data collected via third party targeting cookies is based on your consent, Article 6 sec. 1 sent. 1 lit GDPR.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Video History
analysis.quote: When you view on-demand video on our websites, we may collect your viewing and usage information, and we may share information that identifies you as having viewed particular video content with service providers that enable video functionality, personalization, and usage analysis and third parties for advertising and marketing, as well as editorial purposes.

analysis.headline: Social Media Shares Your Browsing
analysis.quote: If the user is logged in on Facebook at the moment he or she visits the website, Facebook may be able to connect the visit on the website to the user's Facebook account.

analysis.headline: Shares Customer Support Data
analysis.quote: For the most part, customers contacting customer service are directed to our level 1 teams at our Philippines-based data processor Straive (77 Robinson Road, # 13-00 Singapore 068896), if necessary, the service ticket is forwarded to a local level 2 Springer Nature Customer Service team or another relevant team at Springer Nature.

analysis.headline: Keeps Your Data For Years
analysis.quote: By statutory law we are required to retain the provided financial data in relation to transactions (including address, payment and order information) for ten years.

analysis.headline: Creates Your Publication Profile
analysis.quote: Create a profile of your publication record based on publicly available data, such as published books and articles, citations and grants awarded.
